"use client"

import type { ReactNode } from "react"
import { adminPlan } from "@/generated/admin-plan"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function AdminShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  async function logout() {
    await fetch("/api/auth/logout", { method: "POST" })
    window.location.assign({{FIZZYX_LOGIN_ROUTE}})
  }
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-muted/30 md:grid md:grid-cols-[240px_1fr]">
      <aside className="flex flex-col border-b bg-background p-4 md:min-h-screen md:border-b-0 md:border-r">
        <a href="/" className="mb-6 block text-lg font-semibold">{adminPlan.title}</a>
        <nav className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto md:flex-col">
          {adminPlan.resources.map((resource) => <a key={resource.id} href={resource.path} className="rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-muted">{resource.label}</a>)}
        </nav>
        <Button className="mt-4 md:mt-auto" variant="outline" onClick={() => void logout()}>Sign out</Button>
      </aside>
      <main className="min-w-0 p-4 md:p-8">{children}</main>
    </div>
  )
}
